newsitem.title: JAPAN: PRESS DIGEST - Top Japan business news - April 23.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Top Japan business news - April 23.

text.p: Following are some of the leading stories in the Japanese press on Wednesday, as reported by Kyodo news agency.
-- Nomura Securities Co Ltd will name Junichiro Ujiie as its president.
-- Power Reactor and Nuclear Fuel Development Corp (PNC) to privatise uranium enrichment and reprocessing.
-- U.S. President Bill Clinton urges Japan to decelerate budgetary reconstruction if economic recovery slows down.
-- Toyota Motor Corp to introduce stock options system from April 1, 1998.
